title: fix(app-shell): home launcher links and buttons meet the 44 px touch target below sm
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbTfG58JQWNcS6YFBCzbm7jh)_

Fixes #29147

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：手机宽度（640 px 以下）时，Console 首页的链接和按钮都放大到 44 px 触控尺寸：「从模板开始」「New in Studio」等构建按钮与 AI 按钮、「浏览应用市场」「Setup」、「打开收件箱」、两个「查看全部」、我的工作与最近访问的每一行、待发布草稿的「发布」、「查看全部动态」、「收起」。640 px 以上外观不变。
- **为什么改**：首页是登录后的第一屏。实测 375/390 px 下这些入口只有 16 到 32 px 高，低于 44 px，手机上容易点不中或点错（#29075 的审计发现，#29040 系列）。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只在 `@object-ui/app-shell` 首页三个文件加 `max-sm:` 类名，没有新属性、新键或逻辑改动；1280 px 实测尺寸与 main 相同。「Your apps」条带也被 `app:launcher` 区块复用，它在手机上同样变成 44 px。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：① `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomeRail.tsx` 的行与「查看全部」；② `HomePage.tsx` 的 `BuilderChip` 与 `HomeAiActions`；③ `HomeAppsStrip.tsx` 的 `HEADER_LINK_CLASSES`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm dev:showcase`，浏览器调到 390 px 宽打开首页：「Setup」「Open inbox」「View all」和每一行都是约 44 px 高；调回桌面宽度，与改动前一样。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

At phone width the Console home launcher's links and buttons were 16 to 32 px tall. Below `sm` (640 px) each now meets the 44 px touch target, through phone-only `max-sm:` classes, the token form the #29040 children use. From `sm` up the classes are unchanged.

- `HomePage.tsx`: the builder chips ("Start with a template", "Build an app", "New in Studio") and the AI buttons ("Build with AI", "Ask AI"), in the greeting row and in the empty state, take `max-sm:h-11`.
- `HomeAppsStrip.tsx`: the heading links ("Browse App Marketplace", "Setup") take `max-sm:min-h-11` through `HEADER_LINK_CLASSES`; "Show less" takes `max-sm:min-h-11 max-sm:min-w-11`. The app tiles were already 112 by 128 px.
- `HomeRail.tsx`: "Open inbox" and both columns' "View all" take `max-sm:min-h-11 max-sm:min-w-11` (a short label such as "View all" was 42 px wide), and the column header grows to `max-sm:h-11` to hold it. A My-work row's button takes `max-sm:min-h-11` and its list item `max-sm:h-auto`, so the item's 1 px divider sits outside the 44 px button. Recent rows take `max-sm:h-11`; "Publish" in the pending-drafts row takes `max-sm:h-11` in a `max-sm:h-14` row; "View all activity" takes `max-sm:min-h-11`.
- Two `data-testid`s are added so the test can name the targets: `apps-show-less` and `home-activity-view-all`.
- No prop, export, i18n key or metadata changes. `HomeLayout.tsx` and the app bar (#29075) are not touched.

## Run record

Production Console builds served at `/_console` by `pnpm dev:crm` and `pnpm dev:showcase` with `--fresh`: "before" built from main 87d6baef, "after" from the branch at 7a325f0f. Chromium with `isMobile` and touch, DPR 2, signed in as the seeded admin. Every visible interactive element on `/home` outside the app bar is measured, scrolled into view or not.

| Run | Targets | Under 44 px, before | Under 44 px, after |
|---|---|---|---|
| crm 375×812 | 12 | 10 | 0 |
| crm 390×844 | 12 | 10 | 0 |
| showcase 375×812 | 15 | 13 | 0 |
| showcase 390×844 | 15 | 13 | 0 |

Per target on showcase: before at 390, after at 390, after at 1280 (desktop equals before, so desktop is unchanged).

| Target | Before 390 | After 390 | After 1280 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Start with a template | 170×32 | 170×44 | 170×32 |
| New in Studio | 128×32 | 128×44 | 128×32 |
| Browse App Marketplace | 159×16 | 159×44 | 159×16 |
| Setup | 52×16 | 52×44 | 52×16 |
| Open inbox | 63×16 | 63×44 | 63×16 |
| Approvals View all | 42×16 | 44×44 | 42×16 |
| Approval row | 356×39 | 356×44 | 552×39 |
| Notifications View all | 42×16 | 44×44 | 42×16 |
| Notification row | 356×39 | 356×44 | 552×39 |
| Recent row | 356×40 | 356×44 | 734×40 |
| View all activity | 101×16 | 101×44 | 101×16 |

Not measured live: "Build an app", "Build with AI", "Ask AI" (row and empty state), "Publish" and "Show less". The `--fresh` backends deploy no AI agent, no unpublished draft and fewer than 20 apps. The test below pins their classes. Screenshots and the script are in the project folder `issue-29147/`.

## Tests

- New `HomePage.phoneTapTargets-29147.test.tsx` (11 tests, the real `HomePage` with the strip and rail it renders): each target carries its phone class beside its unchanged desktop class. happy-dom computes no media query, so the class is the pin; the run record above is the browser measurement.
- Reverse verification: the three source files restored to main 87d6baef with the test kept: 11 of 11 red. Restored to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Run from `ui/` under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, `--maxWorkers=2`, at merged head 4a492f6e (after the app-shell dependency closure rebuild): the 54 test files that name `HomePage`, `HomeAppsStrip`, `HomeRail` or its exports, the new file included: exit 0, 54 files, 665 tests.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the four changed source and test files: no errors; the warnings are the files' existing `any` and hook warnings, none on a changed line.

## Acceptance notes

- Claim 6572880616 (file surface: `HomePage.tsx`, `HomeRail.tsx`, `HomeAppsStrip.tsx`, their tests, a root changeset). The diff stays inside it.
- `HomeAppsStrip` also renders the `app:launcher` block (`views/app-launcher-renderer.tsx`, `console/blocks/productBlocks.tsx`), so those launchers take the same phone sizes.
- The pending-drafts row now stands 56 px tall below `sm` so its 44 px "Publish" fits; at `sm` and up it stays 40 px.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN; every recorded exit is 0, at 7a325f0f. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 169 files passed, 2 skipped. The merge of main brought no change to the three home files or the test.

- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --concurrency=2` at 7a325f0f: exit 0, 65 of 65 tasks.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main`, `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`, `node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs` and `node scripts/check-partof-closing-keyword.mjs`, with this body as the event: exit 0 each.

- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (CI runs the repo lint)
